description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml which converts an interchange schema to XML format for documentation purposes, including methods for building XML structure from directives and schema data.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml
classes.description: A class that converts HTMLPurifier configuration schema interchange data into an XML format for documentation, extending XMLWriter and providing methods to build XML from directives and schema data.

methods.name: writeHTMLDiv
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML content and writes it inside a div element with XHTML namespace.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a variable to a string representation, handling empty arrays specifically.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire XML document from the interchange schema object.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Builds XML elements for a specific directive within the schema.
